name: Game rule: units fight
source: library/tools/games/faeria.md, The game: units move 1 tile and attack once per turn; reducing the enemy God to 0 wins. Keyword Combat (faeria.com Keyword Rulings): a creature exchanges attacks with creatures, the enemy orb, or structures.

name: Game rule: units harvest
source: library/tools/games/faeria.md, The game: faeria is gained each turn and harvested from the four faeria wells by units next to them.
